description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search unclaimed tax refunds (최근 5년간 미수령 국세환급금). Both txpr_dscm_no and txpr_nm are required by 국세청 — the session TIN does not substitute for them. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.

txpr_dscm_no.description: 납세자식별번호 (사업자등록번호 또는 주민등록번호, 하이픈 없이 숫자만). Required.
